user.title: Kidsnote
user.description: Log in with your Kidsnote account. The password stays in this Home Assistant.

data_description.immich_url: e.g. http://192.168.0.10:2283. Leave empty to skip Immich.
data_description.immich_api_key: Permissions: asset.upload, asset.update, album.read, album.create, albumAsset.create
data_description.delivery_script: Called for each new post. It must end by returning an ok: true response (see README).
data_description.interval_minutes: The first run backs up everything; later runs only look for new posts.

album.title: Immich album
album.description: Pick the Immich album for photos and videos.

data_description.album: An existing album from the list is saved by its id, so renaming it in Immich changes nothing. The template at the top, or a name you type, is matched by name with the child placeholder replaced by the child's name, and created when missing: one album per child.

error.blocked: Kidsnote locked the account after repeated failures. Reset the password on Kidsnote.
error.two_factor: Kidsnote 2-step verification is on, so automatic login is impossible. Turn it off and try again.
error.immich_key_required: An Immich URL needs an API key.
error.immich_auth: Immich rejected the API key. Check the key and its permissions.

abort.already_configured: This Kidsnote account is already set up.
